title: RewardSpec.v1
description: A declarative, reproducible specification for how an environment run is SCORED. Deterministic-by-design: kind is one of deterministic_check (pure assertions over the output), test_execution (run a provided test suite), or diff_oracle (compare against a known-good diff/output). checks[] enumerates the individual scoring units; max_score is the achievable total; requires_execution flags whether scoring needs to run code (and therefore an execution-capable RewardProviderNode + sandbox/policy). A RewardSpec defines the ruler — it never makes the agent output true.

reward_spec_id.description: unique id of this reward spec

kind.description: the scoring mechanism; all three are deterministic given the same input + output

checks.description: the individual scoring units (e.g. {check_id, weight, assertion/test_ref/expected_diff}); their weights should sum to <= max_score

max_score.description: the maximum achievable score for this spec

requires_execution.description: true when scoring must execute code (test_execution); routes to an execution-capable RewardProviderNode + sandbox policy
